title: SAML 2.0 GraphQL-driven setup wizard: metadata synthesis & validation
creator: Maya Patel
description: Build a GraphQL-backed SAML 2.0 setup wizard that synthesizes IdP metadata, validates assertions, and emits audit hooks. The goal is to reduce time-to-onboard for enterprise customers by providing deterministic preflight checks, normalized metadata ingestion, and a dry-run assertion probe before enabling SSO in production. This ticket covers backend schema additions, a validation pipeline, and audit/telemetry contracts consumed by Console UI and the admin audit log service.
acceptance_criteria: Wizard backend exposes GraphQL mutations/queries for metadata ingestion, validation results, and dry-run assertion probes
Metadata ingestion normalizes entityID, ACS URLs, and cert chains; normalization documented with examples
Preflight validation returns deterministic failure categories: cert-invalid, clock-skew, missing-acs, audience-mismatch, signature-mismatch
Dry-run assertion probe can be invoked (IdP-initiated and SP-initiated paths) and returns sanitized SAML response summary without persisting PII
Audit events emitted for metadata upload, validation outcome, assertion-probe result, and admin actions with trace IDs
RBAC enforcement: only org-admin and security-admin roles can finalize/enable SSO after a failing dry-run
E2E test harness exercises 3 IdP fixtures (Okta, ADFS, OneLogin) and is runnable in CI with pass/fail metrics
tasks: Define GraphQL schema for metadata ingest/validation (mutation: ingestSamlMetadata, query: metadataStatus)
Implement metadata normalizer: strip trailing slashes, lower-case host, canonicalize ACS order
Integrate cert chain validator using openssl verification with fallback to fingerprint-only check
Add assertion prober that performs a non-destructive SP-initiated handshake and returns summarized attributes
Wire telemetry: inf_events.saml.setup_started, .metadata_validated, .assertion_probe_result with trace_id and duration_ms
Expose audit log hook: POST to /internal/audit with actor, action, outcome, trace_id
Add RBAC checks at mutation resolvers and console toggles
Create CI e2e job using three IdP fixtures and baseline golden files for normalized metadata
decisions: Use GraphQL rather than adding new REST endpoints to keep state mutations behind typed schema and allow the Console to subscribe to validation progress
Do metadata normalization server-side to avoid inconsistent client implementations
Return only summarized assertion data during dry-run to avoid storing raw PII; full raw responses will be available to customers in their private deployment logs if requested
Failure categories returned as stable machine-readable codes to allow Console UX to render targeted remediation steps
tradeoffs: GraphQL adds complexity to gateway schema and requires client updates, but provides richer subscriptions for progress updates
Running openssl chain verification increases latency of validation (added to backend worker queue) but reduces false positives from cert chain issues
Limiting assertion data reduces forensic detail in the Console but improves compliance posture and PI risk
review_feedback: PM (Ravi Singh): prioritize deterministic failure codes to enable automated remediation suggestions in Console
Design (Lina Torres): need explicit text for admin-only actions and a confirmation modal for enabling SSO after dry-run failures
Security (Anika Roy): must include certificate fingerprint display and a sequence diagram for rotation workflows
Infra (Noah Kim): recommend queuing long-running cert checks and exposing progress via subscription rather than blocking request
